scripts.build: npm run build -w @bitgenetics/aitools-core && npm run build -w @bitgenetics/aitools-cli && npm run build -w @bitgenetics/aitools-server
scripts.test:e2e: docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yml down --volumes --remove-orphans && docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yml up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from e2e
scripts.test:e2e:verbose: docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yml down --volumes --remove-orphans && docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yml up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from e2e
